drawings.description: en bas à gauche, un croquis : un anneau hachuré $\widetilde{\partial P}$ bordé par le cercle $\partial P$
drawings.kind: hatched annulus bordered by a circle
drawings.notes: An annulus between two circles, hatched by short radial strokes (their number schematised), labelled with the tilde-boundary of P inside at the top; the outer circle is labelled del P at the right.

drawings.description: à gauche et à droite, deux croquis de flèches entre $\partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P}$, $\partial P'$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P$, $\widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$ et $P - P' = \widetilde{\partial P} - \partial P'$, avec la mention « équivalences d'\ill{} »
drawings.kind: two arrow sketches between boundaries of P and P'
drawings.notes: Left: del P' and del P above and below, joined by arrows to tilde-del P - del P and tilde-del P - del P' (each followed by an equivalence sign) and to tilde-del P, with "= P - P'" beside; right: del P -> tilde-del P <- del P', with tilde-del P - del P below and P - P' = tilde-del P - del P' above, and "équivalences d'..." under it (the last word illegible, as in the transcription). Arrow directions as on the page; the left sketch is crossed by the large frame line of the page, not drawn.

drawings.description: croquis dans la marge gauche ; sous $P \cap Q = R$, en colonne : $\partial P = T$, le $R$ étant surchargé
drawings.kind: margin diagram of inclusions W, P, Q, P cap Q = R = del P
drawings.notes: Q° over Q, W -> Q (hooked), P inside W (vertical inclusion), P° -> P and P <- P cap Q = R (hooks), and under P cap Q = R, in a column, del P = T; the R is overwritten. The hooks are drawn as small curls at the line ends.
